en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazan, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamani, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created the creatures so He<sup>azwj</sup> Knew what they would be coming to, and Commanded them and Forbade them. So whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded them with from something, so He<sup>azwj</sup> has Made the way for them to neglect it, and they would not happen to be taking to it nor neglecting except by the Permission of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
